about.title: About.
about.titleMuted: Built in Angola. Open to the world.
about.supportBody: A star on GitHub helps other people find the project. A well-written resource helps even more. If there is ever sponsorship, it pays for infrastructure, never for a position in the list.
about.p1d: A resource gets in if it would be missed when gone, not because it has lots of stars.
about.p3d: Static site, little JavaScript and performance targets in CI.
about.p4d: Every resource has a concrete description and, when possible, why it is here.
about.p5d: Code, data and decisions on GitHub.
